bioconda.name: sracat
bioconda.summary: A command-line tool for extracting unordered read data from SRA files.
bioconda.description: sracat is small C++ program that uses the NCBI sra-toolkit C++ API to extract sequence (and optionally quailty scores) from SRA records. Unlike the fasterq-dump program included with the sra-toolkit, sracat does not output the reads in their origianlly submitted order, but rather outputs reads in the order in which they are stored in the SRA file.
